newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee closes flat in dull trade.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee closes flat in dull trade.

text.p: The Sri Lanka rupee closed unchanged after moving in a tight range with the upside capped by the Central Bank top and the downside cushioned by slight buying, dealers said.
The rupee closed at its opening level of 57.04, up from Thursday's closing level of 57.07.
"Trading was dull and hemmed in by the Central Bank top and slight buying pressure," said a Commercial Bank dealer.
Overnight call money closed at 17 percent after opening at 15.5 percent, due to two big state borrowers, dealers said.
